headline: New skill: research — verified briefs on any company, person, or market, folded back into your workspace.

items.prompt_template: New skill: research. When you need to learn something that isn't already in your workspace or your meetings, just say 'research [company]', 'look into [company] before my call', 'background on [person]', or 'pull together research on [topic]'. I'll frame it against what you already have on file, run verified web research with citations, and hand you a branded brief — then offer to save the findings into your workspace so they compound into future briefs. It works out of the box on built-in web search (no setup). If you've connected Tavily it searches the web deeper; if you've connected Vibe Prospecting it also verifies company size/revenue, surfaces funding and hiring signals, and identifies the real decision-makers. The brief always shows which sources it used.
